Players Committee card image of [[Emperor's Orders]] (Virtual Set 15), re-issued 20 April 2022 with a new art credit, copyright line and text layout, original game text, no errata mark. Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2640d50/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Dark/hires/emperorsorders.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Dark/hires/emperorsorders.png] as of commit 2640d50 “Set 18 and errata” (20 April 2022).
